,  `state_name` text

CREATE TABLE `mountain` (

,  `country_name` varchar(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
,  `state_name` text

);

CREATE TABLE `river` (

,  `state_name` text
);

CREATE TABLE `mountain` (

,  `mountain_altitude` integer DEFAULT NULL
,  `country_name` varchar(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
,  `state_name` text

);

CREATE TABLE `river` (

);

CREATE TABLE `state` (
